method: Preserved original unverified machine ASR utterance ids and timestamps; categorized candidate entry/no-entry, risk/exit, exception and decision-order speech; deduplicated ids; rejected conflicting identity and invalid intervals.
limitations: Keyword matching produces review candidates, not executable entry or exit rules. Same-session correlations do not prove corrections. The original AV requires independent semantic examination.
privacy: The excerpts remain in private ChatGPT Library folder, not in this public GitHub report.
